title: Simulated Cloth
description: A 96 by 96 linen sheet uses a plain-weave PBR microstructure and a WebGPU XPBD solver for yarn-length constraints, shear locking, bending, self-contact, sphere contact, and pointer pinching.
techniques: canvas-generated plain-weave albedo, normal, roughness, and occlusion maps
graph-coloured warp and weft length constraints with nonlinear shear locking
XPBD dihedral bending with rigid and spatial-hash self-collision
GPU position readback for front-face-safe pointer grabbing and pin groups
